project.title: Waves App - Launch & Regional Growth
project.description:
In June 2021, Waves App partnered with Astroshot to launch its entertainment and booking platform in Kuwait. The goal was not only to announce a new app. Waves needed a full creative marketing system that could build awareness, explain the product, drive downloads, grow social media, and support regional expansion.

The challenge
Launching a new app requires more than attractive posts. The brand needed a consistent digital presence, campaign ideas, content production, motion graphics, photography, video, and social media management that could keep the platform visible every month.

Astroshot built the launch and growth engine around that need, combining creative direction, production, animation, campaign planning, and always-on social media execution.

From app launch to always-on growth
Astroshot supported Waves from its first social media launch through a full monthly marketing retainer. The work included social media static posts, motion graphics, video production, photography, animation, contest videos, and campaign content designed to keep Waves active, relevant, and easy to understand.

Brand collaborations and campaign momentum
As Waves grew, Astroshot helped produce collaborative content and marketing campaigns with major brands including Pizza Hut, Burger King, Kuwait Finance House, and others.

These campaigns helped position Waves as more than a booking app. It became a lifestyle and entertainment platform with recognizable partnerships and constant social media momentum.

Regional expansion
The marketing work supported Waves as it expanded beyond Kuwait into Dubai, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar.

Astroshot continued working with Waves every month for more than five years, supporting the brand until Waves built and hired its own in-house team.

The result
The partnership helped Waves build 60K+ followers, millions of reach and engagements, tens of thousands of app downloads, regional launches across Dubai, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar, a rise to the #2 Entertainment App position on the App Store, and a marketing foundation strong enough to later move in-house.

What started as an app launch became a long-term growth partnership, helping Waves build awareness, users, social proof, and regional presence.

App launch. Multi-year growth. Regional expansion.
